results.text: Efficacy of the H+/K+-adenosine triphosphatase inhibitor omeprazole in peptic ulcer. In duodenal ulcer studies comprising more than 2,000 patients the efficacy of omeprazole in doses of 20-40 mg once daily has been compared with the recommended doses of the H2-receptor antagonists cimetidine and ranitidine. At 2 weeks the differences in healing rates in favour of omeprazole were 12-33%; while they were somewhat lower at 4 weeks, ranging from 4 to 20%.
